shortTitle: Atlas of Electroencephalography in Sleep Medicine
fullTitle: Atlas of Electroencephalography in Sleep Medicine
libraryStatus: Exact Guild Drive book verified from internal title page, editor list, Springer publication metadata, DOI, ISBNs, preface, and contents on 2026-08-07.
bestFor: Visual and conceptual support for EEG waveform recognition during sleep, normal and variant EEG patterns, sleep-stage context, PSG recognition of EEG abnormalities, nocturnal seizure-versus-parasomnia reasoning, REM sleep behavior disorder, narcolepsy/hypersomnia EEG context, sleep-disordered breathing EEG context, and movement-related EEG findings.
authorityBoundary: Use this 2012 atlas as visual and conceptual study support only. The current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 controls sleep staging, scoring rules, technical definitions, and report requirements. ICSD-3-TR controls current diagnostic classification. Current AASM protocols and guidelines control testing and treatment guidance when newer than the atlas.
legacyMetadataCorrection: The older RPSGT app labeled this source as 'Attarian and Undevia.' The verified 2012 Springer book is edited by Hrayr P. Attarian and Magdy Y. Morgan; V3 uses the verified bibliographic identity.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, public chapter/section titles, original Sleep Pathways Guild summaries, and concept locators only. Do not reproduce EEG tracings, figures, tables, images, or substantial protected prose from the atlas.
